summary: Frontend-only test completed for requested changes. /zarzadzanie-powietrzem renders without crash and shows compact clocks between back arrow and trash icon. /akcja/szybki-pomocnik/woda supports swipe gesture between tabs. /ustawienia contains 'Pobierz dane' with correct subtitle; tapping it in web preview does not crash and updates local sync state (last_sync in storage). Code review confirms offline download flow includes Szybki Pomocnik + Procedury and local file caching on native platforms.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing testID/data-testid attributes on key buttons and rows (e.g., back/trash header buttons, 'Pobierz dane', tab items), reducing automation reliability.

react_native_issues.issue: Console reports: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' during category/tab rendering (reproduced on /akcja/szybki-pomocnik/woda).

action_items: Fix React Native 'Unexpected text node' rendering error in szybki-pomocnik card/container JSX and retest swipe flow.
Add testID props to key interactive controls for stable mobile E2E regression coverage.
Main agent should self-test native device/emulator to confirm offline files (images/PDF) are actually written and readable via file:// paths.
critical_code_review_comments: Offline flow implementation in dataService is aligned with requirement: downloadAkcjaDataForOffline fetches both szybki_pomocnik and procedury, localizes content URLs, and persists to AsyncStorage.
On native platforms, FileSystem.downloadAsync is used with dedicated directories for images and PDFs; on web, function safely skips file download and keeps remote URLs.
Settings action 'Pobierz dane' correctly calls downloadAkcjaDataForOffline and refreshes sync timestamp state after success.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use local Expo web preview (http://127.0.0.1:3000) for stable verification. Swipe between tabs on /akcja/szybki-pomocnik/woda is working. Reproduce console issue via that route and inspect JSX around content card/swipe hint containers.
rca_of_issue: RCA for React Native warning/error: repeated console error 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' appears while rendering szybki-pomocnik category card. Repro: open /akcja/szybki-pomocnik/woda, switch tab (tap or swipe), observe console. Likely cause is stray raw whitespace/text node in a <View> container. Mitigation: remove unintended raw text nodes and ensure all textual content is wrapped in <Text>.
test_credentials: Not required for this frontend-only scope (no auth flow tested).
